mission.brief: Create /home/learner/Workshop and its drafts subdirectory. Finish inside Workshop. Both directories must exist; commands and order are your choice.
constraints: All paths and files are virtual. Commands act immediately; there is no Apply step and no host access.
Use only the syntax in Command reference. No quotes, wildcards, shell expansion, pipes, recursion, links, archives, or unsupported options.
Relative and absolute paths are equivalent. The final state and explicitly named activity evidence earn credit; no exact transcript is required.
File-management commands may change only descendants of /home/learner. Other paths and mutation-root nodes are pinned.
Any actual filesystem change clears cat/find verification. Read or discover the final result again. Skipped no-clobber commands do not clear evidence.

objectives.label: Final state: Workshop is a directory
Final state: drafts is a directory

hints: Check your location and parent directories before creating a folder.
mkdir needs an existing parent unless -p is used. You may create the whole tree in one command.
mkdir -p /home/learner/Workshop/drafts creates both folders; cd /home/learner/Workshop finishes the task.

lesson.goal: Create Workshop/drafts and finish inside Workshop.

steps.explanation: mkdir creates a folder beneath an existing parent. New folders use simulated 0755.
-p creates missing parents and accepts an existing directory; it never replaces a file.
Enter the completed workspace. An earlier visit does not satisfy the final-directory objective.
